description_en: Resets the hit count of an access control policy in a specified VPC firewall policy group to zero
description_zh: 将指定的VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略的命中计数清零
name: ResetVpcFirewallRuleHitCount

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To reset the hit count of an access control policy, specify the unique ID of the policy. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

重置访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid
